examples.text: Earlier this week, figures from the Office for National Statistics showed the fertility rate for England and Wales had fallen for the third year in a row to reach a record low of 1.41. The rate represents the average number of live children women can expect to have in their child-bearing life. The figures are part of a long-term trend of declining fertility rates across much of the globe – and experts are still working out exactly what the repercussions will be for our society and economy.
